result.rationale: The mechanism is verifiable in embeddable-host.js.es6: after save, the client does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')));` with no fallback to the server's uncategorized_category_id, so a cleared chooser saves uncategorized on the server but renders an undefined category client-side. Also, `rollbackBuffer()` is only called in `cancel()`, never after a successful `save()`, so the buffered (pre-normalization) host value can persist for re-editing. Minor uncertainty about whether Discourse's store updates the record from the save response, so confidence is mod

judged_text: Post-save client state diverges from the server in admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6: the buffer is never rolled back after a successful save, so re-editing shows the pre-normalization input (e.g. http://foo.com) while the row displays the server-normalized foo.com; and when the category chooser is cleared, the server saves uncategorized_category_id but the client sets category to findById(null) (undefined), so the badge renders blank until reload.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the template binds the edit input to `buffered.host` (`{{input value=buffered.host ...}}`). On successful `save()`, the code only toggles `editToggled` false and never calls `rollbackBuffer()` / otherwise re-syncs the buffer (`host.save(props).then(() => { ... this.set('editToggled', false); })`). Since the server normalizes `host` in `EmbeddableHost` `before_validation` (strips scheme/path), the row can display normalized `host.host` while the buffer can still contain the pre-normalized string when re-editing. Also, when `categoryId` is cleared, the client sends `category_id = null`, but the server sets it to `uncategorized_category_id` (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`). After save, the client forcibly sets `host.category` to `Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))`, which with `null` yields `undefined`, so `{{category-badge host.category}}` can render blank until reload, even though the server stored uncategorized.
